Question ID: STAT_U03_L03_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.BVM.3

Actual value is 90 and predicted value is 84. What is the residual?

feedback.text: Residual = actual - predicted = 90 - 84 = 6.
This reverses the subtraction. Use actual - predicted.
This adds the values instead of subtracting.
This is the predicted value, not the residual.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U03_L03_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.BVM.3

Actual value is 52 and predicted value is 60. How should the residual be interpreted?

feedback.text: The residual is negative, so the model predicted too high.
Residual = 52 - 60 = -8, so the actual value was 8 below the prediction.
An exact prediction would have residual 0.
This adds actual and predicted instead of subtracting.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U03_L03_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.BVM.3

What does a residual of 0 mean?

answer.text: The actual value equals the predicted value

feedback.text: Residual 0 means actual - predicted = 0.
One residual of 0 does not prove the whole model is perfect.

answer.text: The actual value is below the prediction

feedback.text: A negative residual would mean actual is below predicted.
A residual cannot be calculated without a predicted value.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U03_L03_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.BVM.3

What residual pattern supports using a linear model?

feedback.text: A curve suggests a line may not fit well.

answer.text: All residuals getting larger in one direction

feedback.text: That pattern suggests the line is missing structure.
All positive residuals mean the model is consistently underpredicting.
Random scatter around 0 supports a linear fit.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: STAT_U03_L03_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.STAT.BVM.3

What residual pattern suggests a line may not fit well?

answer.text: Residuals both above and below 0 with no pattern

feedback.text: That supports a linear model.
Small residuals suggest close predictions.

answer.text: A curved pattern in the residuals

feedback.text: A curve means the relationship may not be linear.
One exact prediction does not show poor fit.
